import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:io';

import 'package:channel_biseo/app/app.dart';
import 'package:channel_biseo/app/services.dart';
import 'package:channel_biseo/core/logger.dart';
import 'package:channel_biseo/core/secret_store.dart';
import 'package:channel_biseo/features/ai/brain.dart';
import 'package:channel_biseo/stages.dart';
import 'package:channel_biseo/ui/produce_screen.dart';
import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';

import 'helpers.dart';
import 'package:channel_biseo/features/runner/notifier.dart';
import 'package:channel_biseo/features/voice/voice_io.dart';

/// 버전 1.1.0 코드로 실제 사용자 자료 폴더를 만든다 (업데이트 시험용).
void main() {
  test('make v1.1.0 fixture', () async {
    registerStages();
    final out = Directory(Platform.environment['OUT']!)..createSync(recursive: true);
    final base = Directory('${out.path}/support')..createSync();
    final docs = Directory('${out.path}/documents')..createSync();
    final secrets = MemorySecretStore();
    final env = AppEnv(
      baseDir: base.path,
      documentsDir: docs.path,
      secrets: secrets,
      httpClient: noNetwork(),
      logger: AppLogger(),
      speech: FakeSpeechInput(const []),
      speaker: FakeSpeaker(),
      notifier: MemoryNotifier(),
      isDesktop: true,
      platformName: 'test',
      appVersion: '1.1.0+6',
      launchUrl: (u) async => true,
      now: () => DateTime(2026, 10, 20, 9),
    );
    final u = await UserContext.open(env, env.accounts.create('김사장', '1234'));
    for (final pl in AppState.plugins) {
      await pl(u);
    }
    final s = u.settings;
    s.onboardingDone = true;
    s.textScale = 1.5;
    s.themeMode = 'dark';
    s.reduceMotion = true;
    s.haptics = false;
    await u.youtube.connectGoogle();
    for (final c in u.youtube.channels()) {
      await u.youtube.syncChannel(c.channelId);
    }
    await u.edits.apply(await u.edits.plan('UC_mock_cook'));
    final ps = productionOf(u);
    await ps.create(channelId: 'UC_mock_cook', format: ContentFormat.shorts, topic: '김치찌개 끓이기');
    u.memos.add('강릉 커피거리 영상');
    await u.ai.setKey('sk-ant-fixture-key');
    u.close();
    env.accounts.db.close();
    File('${out.path}/secrets.json').writeAsStringSync(const JsonEncoder.withIndent(' ').convert(secrets.data));
  });
}
